purpose: Prospective manual qualification of consequential-choice final handoffs on the current kit, with retained historical prompts and a matched settled-choice control.
freeze_rule: Retain these bytes before native inference. Record this file's SHA-256 in each preparation/run manifest. Later rubric changes require a new versioned protocol and separate grades; never silently alter this protocol or historical grades.

boundaries.host: Claude native host; record the actual host version, selected and reported model labels, setup route and observed role identity per attempt.
boundaries.scope: Three bounded intake/final-handoff cases. Current-kit behavior is separate from the September controls, literal-criteria comparisons, and any later production work.
boundaries.production: No live provider call is required to qualify the handoff. Record actual provider/tool availability without inferring it from configuration. Do not create a paid production obligation to satisfy this rubric.
claims_excluded: General reliability or host superiority from one attempt per case.
Historical timeout repaired by a later completed attempt.
Same-parent or same-child continuation of the historical Claude trial from an artifact restart.
Artistic, provider or target-engine acceptance from local validation or prepared plans.
Automatic native role discovery from explicitly supplied registration or file presence.

original_protocol.grading: Manual criterion review of native events and files; no expected-answer or completion-event pass.

original_criteria.text: Final response directly asks the next necessary consequential user choice.
Question is concise and explains what its answer unlocks.
Existing authorization is not requested again.
Reference dimensions and proposals do not become confirmed instructions or universal rules.
Useful independent work and existing project state are preserved.
Remote generation, visual acceptance and engine outcomes are reported from actual evidence.

cases.prompt: Make a character family matching this project, using PIXL. The supplied references disagree about outline treatment and I have not chosen the final canvas size. The family will have a scout and a medic for a side-view game. References are reference.png and reference-b.png. Begin the project and make the progress possible in this session.
cases.prompt_authority: Verbatim fresh_prompt in the original protocol. Historical full invocation additionally retained at evidence/skill-handoff/revised-routing/runs/claude-intake-01/prompt.txt.
cases.input: Fresh isolated project containing the retained reference fixture bytes and current frozen kit/setup; do not seed an expected final response.
cases.behavioral_boundary: The actual final response makes only the missing consequential choice(s) actionable, explains the immediate work they unlock, and reports useful independent inspection/planning already saved. It preserves the scout/medic side-view brief and does not treat either reference's dimensions or outline as an adopted requirement.

cases.prompt: Use PIXL to continue this character-family project from its saved files. Report the current decisions, unresolved dependencies and next useful action.
cases.prompt_authority: Verbatim cold_prompt in the original protocol.

seed.mode: Copied retained artifacts in a new native session; artifact-based restart.
seed.preparation: Retain an immutable original-input inventory. Declare any isolated-copy setup/library-source retention adjustments in a separate preparation receipt with before/after hashes. Do not mutate the historical project or silently present a repaired seed as untouched.
seed.exclusion: This seed is the actual interrupted Claude project, not the old matched Codex seed named by the September protocol.

cases.behavioral_boundary: Recover actual saved choices, observations, plans and unresolved dependencies from the copied project. Read the relevant cold-intake guidance and carry the still-needed question into the final response. Preserve prior project history and avoid redoing independent work without a reason. Use existing authorization.

cases.prompt_basis: Matched handoff-only control using the supplied decisions below; preserve their meaning exactly. The control ledger retains scenario facts and responses, not a byte-exact original host prompt. Freeze the actual new invocation separately before inference.
cases.supplied_state: Local contracts, plans and review criteria are saved in START-HERE.md; no generation provider, candidate or target engine is available.
cases.setup_disclosure: If these facts are supplied rather than created by the host, describe this as a supplied-state wording control. The current preparation may create retained fixture files, but must not claim native authorship of those files.
cases.behavioral_boundary: Use the settled choices and existing authorization; do not ask the user to reconfirm them or manufacture another consequential choice. Report the saved work and concrete next authorized operation, with actual unavailable provider/engine boundaries.
cases.C1_C2_applicability: Not applicable because the defined choices are settled. Record the distinct S1 check below; do not count an unnecessary question as a C1 pass.

additional_check.text: No redundant decision or permission question is introduced; the final gives a concrete next operation using the supplied decisions and established authorization.

prompt_separation.host_inputs: Only the ordinary scenario prompt, actual reference/project artifacts, and factual environment/ownership/setup instructions. Freeze exact per-run prompt bytes and hashes.
prompt_separation.evaluator_only: This protocol, criterion labels, expected-answer wording, historic successful responses and manual grade decisions must not be supplied as the host assignment.
prompt_separation.interventions: If guidance or corrections are needed after a failed attempt, preserve the original attempt and record the intervention verbatim; grade the new guided outcome separately.

separate_observation_checks.requirement: Locate the actual final assistant/caller response in the native event stream, with source file and event/line identifier. Distinguish progress text, saved handoff text, specialist output and caller final. A process exit, timeout, init event or success subtype alone does not establish a completed handoff.
separate_observation_checks.missing_evidence: Mark final-boundary behavioral criteria unverified; retain independently observed partial work.

separate_observation_checks.requirement: Record run ID, parent session ID, any native child IDs and declared role, host/version and selected/reported model labels, actual OS/host termination and any continuation. The cold case starts a new session from retained artifacts; never label it continuation of the old session.
separate_observation_checks.missing_evidence: Limit claims to observed identities; do not infer same child from the role name.

separate_observation_checks.requirement: Independently identify actual native loading/read evidence for the full canonical profile, main skill and relevant intake reference from the tested kit. Record exact loaded paths/hashes and whether loading is built-in host injection, explicit source read or merely asserted. Cold routing must be supported by actual reference loading.
separate_observation_checks.missing_evidence: Report loading/conformance separately as unverified or failed as applicable; a behavior pass does not repair missing required instruction-loading evidence.

separate_observation_checks.requirement: Inspect actual saved files and applicable state. Confirm that claimed independent progress exists and is useful to the same brief; verify exact current state/store paths and run relevant read-only validate/workflow reports using the tested kit. For the supplied-state settled control, distinguish fixture facts from native work.
separate_observation_checks.missing_evidence: Do not certify saved work from a response assertion or valid syntax alone.

separate_observation_checks.requirement: Compare pre/post inventories for original references, historical project records and declared retained sources. Preserve earlier attempts, grades, setup faults, failed commands and pre-intervention artifacts. New state must advance through supported history rather than rewrite the historical seed.
separate_observation_checks.missing_evidence: State the unverified preservation scope rather than assuming all earlier files are unchanged.

separate_observation_checks.requirement: Compare final assertions and relevant new/revised saved choices to the brief and retained sources. Keep unresolved, observed, proposed, confirmed and conflict semantics distinct. Preserve adopted choices and established authorization; measurements and proposals cannot become invented owner instructions.
separate_observation_checks.missing_evidence: A successful validator or producing model self-audit does not establish authority preservation.

separate_observation_checks.requirement: Record human acceptance as unperformed. Describe any provider, image inspection, visual or engine evidence only at the layer actually observed. No generation or engine work is required by this handoff protocol.
separate_observation_checks.missing_evidence: Leave the corresponding outcome unverified; do not promote local preparation to production acceptance.

manual_review.method: An independent reviewer reads the actual final plus relevant transcript and saved artifacts. Judge semantic meaning and usefulness rather than exact wording or substring matches. Record each original criterion separately from O1-O7 and S1.
manual_review.incomplete_cases: Authentication failures, host limits, missing final responses and recording failures remain explicit. A completed final can be reviewed independently when its native event is retained, while missing process evidence remains a separate limit.
manual_review.failure_handling: Preserve the first failure and every subsequent correction. A later success applies only to its own tested input/instruction/session identity.
manual_review.completion_rule: Bounded qualification requires an observed completed handoff for fresh and cold unresolved cases satisfying C1-C6, plus the settled control satisfying C3-C6 and S1, with separately reported loading, identity, artifact and preservation findings. Any material missing evidence limits the result instead of being waived.
manual_review.broad_limit: These three cases do not close general artistic judgment, long-gap/native-host reliability, human acceptance or PLAN milestones.

source_anchors.purpose: Existing task, original outcomes, stopping condition and preserved failure boundaries.
Caller context, source authority, consequential questions, independent work and existing authorization.
Saved-state recovery, actual final question, useful progress, what answers unlock, and settled-choice behavior.
Native completion, caller question, independent work and authority.
Intake meanings, planned vs materialized outputs, read-only workflow and evidence/acceptance separation.
workflow, job_report and family_report public read implementations.
Document validation; not behavioral or artistic grading.
